entries.rationale: The installer runs before the TypeScript payload exists. It needs the same token renderer without importing compiled code.
evidence: tests/unit/projection.test.ts: installer and compiled projection renderers stay byte-identical

entries.rationale: The installer must render policy rules before a compiled TypeScript payload exists.
evidence: tests/unit/projection.test.ts: installer and compiled projection renderers stay byte-identical

entries.rationale: The mutually exclusive reviewer roles need the same verdict boundary in their independent judgment guidance.
evidence: tests/unit/policies.test.ts: representative review contexts resolve distinct review policy sets

entries.rationale: The planner persona absorbs the tech lead's planning judgment for the delivery workflow while the dev workflow still delegates to the tech lead. The two roles never run in the same workflow.
Each independently invoked entry command must prevent nested supervision before it adopts the shared supervisor persona.
Only one installation-specific bootstrap rule is projected. Both variants must retain the same supervisor and retrieval invariants.
evidence: tests/unit/projection.test.ts: self-development and embedded projection coverage

entries.rationale: Each language policy independently guards its formatter-owned appendix and can be delivered without the other policy.
Each generated language handbook must state its own bounded unknowns because agents read only guidance for relevant languages.

PLAN-002 consolidates the intake and planning disciplines for the delivery workflow while the dev workflow still binds INTAKE-001 and PLAN-001 to its separate stages. The shared instructions must stay aligned until one workflow supersedes the other.
evidence: governance/registries/policy_lookup_table.json: dev binds INTAKE-001/PLAN-001, delivery binds PLAN-002

entries.rationale: VERIFY-001 consolidates review and QA norms for the delivery workflow while the dev workflow still binds TEST-001 to its separate QA stage. The shared QA evidence rules must stay aligned until one workflow supersedes the other.
evidence: governance/registries/policy_lookup_table.json: dev binds TEST-001, delivery binds VERIFY-001

entries.rationale: The verifier persona absorbs the reviewer's independent-verification judgment for the delivery workflow while the dev workflow still delegates to the reviewer. The two roles never run in the same workflow.

The two remediator personas share the reproduce-repair-prove discipline but carry different authority: the severe variant may amend the plan, the ordinary variant may not. The verify verdict selects exactly one per attempt, so the shared discipline must stay aligned in both.

Both workflows share the release-steward ship procedure; the delivery variant differs only in which verification evidence it references. The prompts must stay aligned until one workflow supersedes the other.
